title: TAIFEX dataset refresh must run on the candidate stack and never block the release
hosted_verification_note: No hosted workflow was dispatched (neither nonprod-deploy.yml nor dev-tw-market-refresh.yml) and no VM or SSH access was performed. Functional and contract evidence only is recorded here; hosted verification is deferred to the next automatic dev release and operator acceptance task INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.

summary.nonprod_deploy_workflow: Moved step id=taifex_market_refresh ('Refresh TAIFEX contract dataset under lease after candidate stack deploy') after step id=deploy ('Deploy dev VM stack under lease') and its candidate readiness gates while keeping TWSE refresh step id=market_refresh before stack mutation. Configured id=taifex_market_refresh (--non-blocking) and id=bounded_taifex_refresh (--force --non-blocking) with continue-on-error: true, printing captured redacted logs when present, writing normalized outcome JSON to steps.release_admission.outputs.evidence_dir/taifex-market-refresh.json, and uploading it via step id=taifex_market_refresh_upload ('Upload TAIFEX contract refresh evidence', if: always() when either refresh step ran).
summary.dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow: Configured step id=taifex_refresh in .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml after step id=refresh (TWSE) with continue-on-error: true, --non-blocking, printing captured redacted logs when present, and normalized outcome JSON recording (status, reason, redacted one-shot log).
summary.deploy_nonprod_vm_script: Added --non-blocking flag (NON_BLOCKING_REFRESH=true), closed-session preflight priority (weekend, holiday, session_not_closed checked before dataset_missing / closed_session_missing in check_taiwan_refresh_preflight), redacted one-shot container log capture (last 200 lines), non-blocking outcome persistence (status, reason, log) for failed/skipped TAIFEX refreshes without failing the release or triggering compensation, while preserving fail-closed behaviour for TWSE refresh failures and restoring external egress to deny and source controller to reconcile_only on every path.
summary.release_manifest_validation: Added load_taifex_market_refresh producer helper and taifex_market_refresh parameter on build_manifest in scripts/deploy/release_manifest.py to populate and validate dev_verification.taifex_market_refresh (status in {completed, noop, skipped, failed}, non-empty reason string, and log string).

acceptance_criteria_verification.1_post_mutation_taifex_step_order: Verified by test_nonprod_deploy_workflow_wires_taifex_refresh_after_candidate_deploy in scripts/test_source_ingest_deploy_diagnostics_contract.py and test_nonprod_deploy_workflow_runs_taifex_refresh_post_mutation_non_blocking_and_records_evidence in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py: market_refresh (TWSE) stays before deploy, and taifex_market_refresh, bounded_taifex_refresh (--force --non-blocking), and taifex_market_refresh_upload run after deploy and artifact_candidate_upload.
acceptance_criteria_verification.2_non_blocking_taifex_failure_and_fail_c: Verified by test_refresh_entrypoint_taifex_non_blocking_failure_continues_and_records_redacted_log_while_twse_fails_closed in scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh.py and test_nonprod_deploy_workflow_runs_taifex_refresh_post_mutation_non_blocking_and_records_evidence in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py (asserting taifex_market_refresh_upload artifact upload, log printing, and release_manifest.build_manifest producer/validator support for dev_verification.taifex_market_refresh).
